name: es-non-resident-income-tax-irnr-and
description: Use this Guide to select and compute Spain’s ordinary non-resident and departure tax routes for 2026. It covers individual residence, Spanish-source income, income without a permanent establishment, EU and EEA expense conditions, rental and own-use property, pensions, investment gains, purchaser withholding, Modelo 210 and Modelo 211. It also supplies an ordinary permanent-establishment accounting-to-tax method, branch remittance tests, asset-transfer charges and individual shareholding exit-tax thresholds, valuation, elections and filing clocks. Trigger phrases include IRNR, no residente, Modelo 210, establecimiento permanente, renta imputada, comprador retención tres por ciento, cambio de residencia and exit tax Spain. Obtain actual residence, source, treaty, ownership, accrual, cost and election evidence before calculating.
